items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 88:1
items.html: RADLA, as well as the three heads of Arich Anpin, are called by the name Atika Kadisha (the Holy Ancient One). (Page 301, Item 8).
